record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, increase each NextItNet block's residual scale from 0.5 to 0.65. Since 0.35 regressed, modestly stronger convolutional updates may improve contextual modeling. Keep causal blocks, dilation schedule, features, embeddings, readout, scoring, loss and optimizer fixed. Synchronize residual-scale metadata and predictor-writer checks; retain one checkpoint per category.
